description: This source file defines the class InfoFieldRenderer which is responsible for rendering information fields (such as author, title, keywords, subject) into RTF format within the MigraDoc document processing library. It extends the FieldRenderer class and provides functionality to output specific document metadata in RTF.

classes.name: InfoFieldRenderer
classes.description: A class responsible for rendering an InfoField object into RTF format, extending the FieldRenderer base class, specific to the MigraDoc library.

methods.name: Render
methods.description: Renders the InfoField into RTF by writing the appropriate field identifier based on the field's name.

methods.name: GetFieldResult
methods.description: Retrieves the value of the specified info field from the associated document, returning an empty string if the field is not present or null.
